snippet.title: DeathBall Arcade Game Season 3 Update, Power-Ups, Gameplay, and More
snippet.description:
Let's check out what's new with DeathBall! DeathBall Arcade Game was developed by Tony Hauber in Elkader, Iowa. Tony is here to tell us about all of the updates to DeathBall Arcade Game. This indie arcade game has been making waves in the arcade space selling cabinets all over the country and building amazing communities. The Season 3 update of DeathBall Arcade Game bring in new maps, new power-ups, and more features for returning players. With DeathBall 4-Player coming in the future, season 3 is sure to bring excitement to your local league night. Find your local arcade and let them know season 3 of DeathBall Arcade Game is here.

If you or your local arcade want a DeathBall cabinet here where you can get it, https://www.indiearcadewave.com/indie-games/deathball

If you like what we are doing here at Indie Arcade Wave don't forget to like, share, and subscribe. It helps us a ton, the wave will continue to grow and we can all ride it together.

If you are looking to buy new or used Stern pinballs email me at Indiearcadewave@gmail.com.
